//: VFM Universal Code Conventions — MANDATORY for EVERY TypeScript/JavaScript project, frontend AND backend. Merge into the project's ESLint config, then merge the area-specific file on top (templates/frontend/eslintrc.frontend.json or templates/backend/eslintrc.backend.json). These are the naming/import/safety conventions that used to live only as a prose table in core/cto.md — a convention nobody lints is a convention that drifts.
//verify: After merging: `npx eslint --print-config <any-source-file> | grep naming-convention` MUST return a match. A gate you did not grep for is a gate you do not have.

//optional.note: These need extra plugins. Enable them if the plugin is present — do NOT paste them in without installing, ESLint fails on an unknown rule id.
//optional.import/order: npm i -D eslint-plugin-import — then add: "import/order": ["error", { "groups": ["builtin","external","internal","parent","sibling","index","type"], "newlines-between": "always", "alphabetize": { "order": "asc", "caseInsensitive": true } }]
//optional.unicorn/filename-case: npm i -D eslint-plugin-unicorn — file naming is otherwise checked by google-code-reviewer §1 (PascalCase components, kebab/camelCase utils, use* hooks)

//limits: max-lines 300 / max-lines-per-function 30 are the SAME numbers as helpers/code-quality.md (one threshold, not two). max-params 4 / max-nested-callbacks 3 / complexity 10 / max-depth 4 encode that file's 'Code Smells to Avoid' list. On an existing codebase already in violation: set the offending rule to 'warn', keep a burn-down list, restore 'error' at zero. Deleting a rule to make lint green is a regression, not a fix.
